text:
Ranking one positive against 99 fixed negatives measures discrimination within that candidate set, not full-catalog retrieval. Sampled HR@10 generally inflates hits and can reverse model comparisons even in expectation; uniform and popularity sampling both produce inconsistent rankings in sequential recommendation. Fixed candidates make comparisons reproducible but leave sampling bias intact; repeated tuning can overfit those candidates. Stability therefore establishes only conditional stability, not full-catalog top-k overlap or rank preservation. [Krichene–Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/); [sequential-recommendation study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.13045).

Recommended complementary audit: retain the pinned evaluator unchanged; separately score all eligible unseen items for the same 20 training users, five/category. Compare baseline and proposed model using overlap@k = |A∩B|/k, entering/leaving items, and rank changes for shared items; identify target absence explicitly when comparing sampled versus catalog rankings. These are descriptive stability measures, not relevance estimates. Freeze histories, exclusions, item mapping, precision and k. Break exact ties by descending score then ascending canonical item ID, including at the cutoff; report tie frequency. PyTorch warns that tied `topk` indices are unstable. [PyTorch documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.topk.html).

Recommended uncertainty protocol: save per-user outcomes; use 10,000 bootstrap replicates with a recorded RNG seed, resampling users with replacement within each category and applying identical indices to both models. Recompute each category’s paired mean difference, then average the four category differences equally; report the observed difference and 95% percentile interval. Paired resampling preserves correspondence. Intervals condition on fixed candidates and fitted models, excluding candidate-sampling, training-seed and selection uncertainty. Five users/category makes audit intervals exploratory. [SciPy paired-bootstrap documentation](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html).
